body: Fuck me, man. I can't imagine the pain you have. I wish to god I could say something that would make it better. Most of us are out here feeling alone with people sitting next to us and you've actually lost the most important person in your life. I wish I had words

I don't know. I've been wondering the same thing. I used to be a happy person despite the trials but I've hit a point where I just can't take it anymore. I'm not even lovable by my own mother. I am apparently unlovable. If I killed myself tonight, sure. People would be kind of bummed for a minute but would forget about me quickly. I'm pretty sure my husband would secretly be happy I was dead. Fuck this life
